channel.title: POLITICO Influence
channel.description: Delivered daily, Influence gives you a comprehensive rundown and analysis of all lobby hires and news on K Street.

item.title: Inside a Senate aide’s quiet business deals
item.description: Brent Robertson, chief of staff for Sen. Roger Marshall, didn’t disclose an unusual business relationship with a government relations executive. Nor did he disclose potential income from the sale of a $2 million house by an LLC he set up with that executive.
item.dc:creator: By Daniel Lippman and Jacob Wendler
item.dc:contributor: By Daniel Lippman and Jacob Wendler

item.title: The Trump attorney who helped UNC get its deal
item.description: This week’s deal between the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and the Trump administration came after the university hired one of President Donald Trump’s former defense attorneys to help it navigate discussions with the Justice Department.
item.dc:creator: By Jacob Wendler
item.dc:contributor: By Jacob Wendler

item.title: Pentagon aide’s wife won’t lobby DOD after all
item.description: The wife of the Pentagon’s chief of staff, who on Sunday registered to lobby the Pentagon as part of her new job, will no longer work to influence the Defense Department.

item.title: The kratom millionaires quietly boosting the GOP

item.title: Ex-lawmaker sentenced to 10 years in FARA case
